description: This file defines the `MusicRepository` class which manages access to the device's music library via Android's MediaStore API and provides in-memory playlist management functionality. It includes methods for loading music tracks with optional search query filtering, creating playlists, and modifying playlist contents.

classes.name: MusicRepository
classes.description: A repository class that interfaces with Android's MediaStore to fetch music tracks and manages playlists stored in memory.

methods.name: loadLibrary
methods.description: Suspending function that queries the device's media store to retrieve a list of music tracks, with optional filtering based on a search query.

methods.name: getAlbumArtUri
methods.description: Private helper method that constructs a URI for the album art given an album ID.

methods.name: getPlaylists
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of existing playlists.

methods.name: createPlaylist
methods.description: Creates a new playlist with a given name and assigns it a unique ID.

methods.name: addToPlaylist
methods.description: Adds a track ID to a specified playlist.

methods.name: removeFromPlaylist
methods.description: Removes a track ID from a specified playlist.
